skill.summary: 通用文生图技能。使用 MiniMax、OpenAI、DALL-E、Stability 等模型生成图片。用户需要配置自己的 API Key（MINIMAX_API_KEY、OPENAI_API_KEY 等）。当用户需要生成图片、AI绘图时使用此技能。

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of xiaoxia-image-gen: a versatile text-to-image skill.
- Supports MiniMax, OpenAI DALL-E, and Stability AI models (user-configurable API Keys).
- Auto-selects preferred model in order: MiniMax > OpenAI > Stability.
- Simple prompts for generating various image styles directly in OpenClaw.
- Provides example prompts and easy environment variable setup.
